name: danmaku-echo
description: One-click danmaku echoing for Huya Live, Bilibili Live, and Douyin Live

scripts.check: node tests/validate-manifest.js && node --check background/service-worker.js && node --check src/shared.js && node --check src/content.js && node --check src/douyin-bootstrap.js && node --check src/douyin-page-hook.js && node --check src/douyin-content.js && node --check popup/popup.js && node --check tests/fixture-server.js && node --check tests/inspect-live-dom.js && npm test
scripts.package: node scripts/sync-version.js && npm run check && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package.ps1
